name: agent-toolkit
description: Reusable engineering skills for project guidance, requirements, technical design, HTML mocks, design systems, application demo videos, and narrated explainer videos.

interface.shortDescription: Project guidance, requirements, designs, mocks, design systems, and videos
interface.longDescription: Generate agent instruction files, define traceable L1/L2 requirements, create detailed software designs with diagrams, write HTML mocks for every screen and state, extract design systems with verified contrast, record verified application demos, and build narrated slide-deck videos using seven bundled engineering skills.
defaultPrompt: Create agent instruction files for a new project.
Define L1 and L2 requirements for my application.
Create HTML mocks for every page, dialog and notification in every state.
Extract the design system from docs/mocks/.
Create a demo video for each executable application in this repository.
Create a narrated video that explains a feature of this repository.
